components.description: Unwinder - feeds substrate into the press web path
Rewinder - collects substrate after printing
Primer Web Handling System - feeds substrate at required printing speed by engaging it to the blanket; maintains constant and controlled tension; holds HW elements for in-line priming
Spectrophotometer - PQ device embedded in web subsystem
In Line Scanner - PQ device embedded in web subsystem
In Line Primer - comprised of 3 main components: Corona unit, Liquid unit, Drying unit

Corona unit - applies high voltage to electrode ionizing surrounding air to produce corona discharge (plasma); bombards substrate surface with high-energy electrons to improve ink adhesion; produces ozone as side-effect which is ejected outside the press

Liquid unit - loads primer into chamber; roller dipped in chamber is driven by motor; set of rollers passes primer thin layer to substrate; when substrate stops, final roller disengages (milling mode); wash process pumps water to clean rollers

events.description: Default failure classification for any error that causes print to stop, unless another specific error caused the failure and this event follows it.

events.whatToDo: 1. Verify DFE side is not restarted or not shut down. 2. If disconnection type is DFE verify with the Pre-Press if it was unmapped from DFE. 3. If disconnection type is "Failure" verify Press communication network cable is connected, if not verify the cable is properly connected.

events.name: PipelineSessionEndTimeout
